Not tested live: if cosmic-comp lacks zwlr_gamma_control, the icon stays off and the error goes to stderr. The user wants gamma set direc…
- [k2] libcosmic is pinned by rev in Cargo.toml and the justfile builds with --locked; bump the rev on purpose. Not verified live: cosmic-comp advertising zwlr_gamma_control, and the desktop file's Categories on a COSMIC session.

[package.metadata.deb]
name = "cosmic-ext-nightlight"
maintainer = "cosmic-ext-nightlight contributors"
section = "x11"
priority = "optional"
extended-description = "A COSMIC panel applet that toggles night light by setting display gamma through the Wayland wlr-gamma-control protocol."
# $auto adds the shared libraries the binary links (libc, libwayland-client, ...).
# cosmic-panel is what hosts the applet; cosmic-comp provides the gamma protocol.
depends = "$auto, cosmic-panel, cosmic-comp"
assets = [
    ["target/release/cosmic-ext-nightlight", "usr/bin/", "755"],
    ["data/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight.desktop", "usr/share/applications/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-on-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-off-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
]

[profile.release]

## Build a .deb package

Install `cargo-deb` once (`cargo install cargo-deb`), then:

```sh
just deb                # cargo deb --locked; builds the release binary too
sudo apt install ./target/debian/cosmic-ext-nightlight_*.deb
```

The package installs the same files as `just install` and depends on the
shared libraries the binary links (detected automatically), plus `cosmic-panel`
and `cosmic-comp`. Remove it with `sudo apt remove cosmic-ext-nightlight`.

## Add it to the panel
